Statistics Canada’s Canadian Community Health Survey reports millions of Canadians without a regular primary-care provider. CIHI and provincial agencies publish wait-time and workforce data. “Systemic failure that kills” is severity language — death claims need specific mortality studies, not attachment rates alone.
On the record: attachment rates, wait times, workforce counts, CHA framework.
Inference (labeled): multi-million unattached populations imply system capacity failure. Assigning blame to a single party or program requires primary evidence beyond the headline rate.
